column1: # Phase 4: the phone page (android/launcher/src/main/assets/phone/index.html → index.en.html, src/phone_en.py)
# arabic<TAB>english, one per line, as docs/ENGLISH.md says. tests/i18n_test.py checks every entry.
# In the order the page has them. «تلفزيونك» is Your TV, «شاشة تلفزيونك» the Your TV Screen app (as page.tsv); the accessibility service, whose
# Android label stays Arabic, is “Your TV: phone control and typing” (as home.tsv). The counts are English in src/phone_en.py (nn: [one, two, few] → one
# or few); what the hook cannot see or a table cannot say (word order, the left-to-right style, the language link) is its EN_CODE: the
# entries of the code it replaces («بقي », «وضع الأطفال: ») are here for completeness and never reach the page.

column1: يُكتب النص في الحقل النصي المفتوح، ويُضاف مهمةً إذا كانت شاشة «المهام» مفتوحة، وفي التطبيقات الأخرى يُكتب في حقلها بعد تفعيل خدمة إمكانية الوصول. ومن دون الخدمة: أندرويد لا يسمح لتطبيق بالكتابة داخل تطبيق آخر، فيُنسخ النص إلى حافظة التلفزيون.
column2: It goes into the open text field, or becomes a task when Tasks is open. In other apps it goes into their field once the accessibility service is on. Without it, Android doesn’t let one app type into another, so the text is copied to the TV’s clipboard.

column2: The TV fetches our latest version and checks that it is signed with the same key as the installed app. If all is well, press Install: Android’s install screen opens on the TV, and you confirm with the remote. Nothing is installed without your OK.
